# v2026.11.13

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.13.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.13.md).

This release covers **4 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- No Charge with a reason: a rule or a person marks a job No Charge as Promotion, Internal, Remake, Rework, Warranty or Goodwill, and the job leaves Reconcile. ([#526](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/526))
- GST follows Xero: each Xero sync copies every Xero item's GST onto its price item, and sets "Prices include GST" from Xero's default sales tax. ([#527](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/527), [#528](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/528))
- A job whose work-system GST differs from its price item waits for a person, and a draft whose GST differs from its Xero item never goes. ([#527](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/527), [#528](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/528))

## Changes

- No Charge reasons in Settings, a reason on each No Charge rule, and a reason choice on a job. ([#526](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/526))
- "Prices include GST" and "Invoice line GST" settings; tax-inclusive invoices show "Includes GST 10%". ([#527](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/527))
- "Invoice line GST" now defaults to Price list. ([#528](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/528))

## Fixes

- With prices that include GST, the work system's prices are read as its total less tax, so GST-free lines count. ([#528](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/528))

[CHANGELOG/records/2026.11.13.md](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/blob/main/CHANGELOG/records/2026.11.13.md) lists every pull request in this release once, with its related issues and thanks.
